resources.string: Android only lets an app change the system theme after it has been granted WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. Do this once, either way below, and it sticks.
Install the free Shizuku app, open it, tap “Start via Wireless debugging” and follow its steps. Then come back here and tap the button.
Shizuku isn\'t running. Open it and tap Start.
Status: Shizuku is installed but its service is not running. Open Shizuku and tap Start, then come back.
Status: Shizuku v%1$d is running. Tap the button and allow Light Switch.
Status: Shizuku v%1$d is running and Light Switch is allowed.
Enable USB debugging, connect the phone, and run this in a terminal:
adb shell pm grant com.samhrncir.lightswitch android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Come back to this app afterwards; the card disappears once the permission is granted.
Couldn\'t change the theme. Grant the permission below first.
Couldn\'t change the theme on this device.
